Name: Abiel
Summary: Abiel was the father of Kish and of Ner, making him the grandfather of Saul and of Abner, Saul's commander.
KeyStory: Abiel's two sons fathered both Israel's first king and his army's captain.
RelatedPeople: Kish, Son of Abiel; Ner, Son of Abiel
LifeLesson: One household can shape a nation's whole first generation of leadership.
